_whose: This file belongs to the person who runs Granite Record, like member_corrections.json and ballot_results.json. Claude laid out its shape on 16 October 2026, empty; every entry in it is the person's. No generator writes it, and preflight fails if any build_* or fetch_* script opens it for writing (HANDMADE).
_what: What the person settles about the members-elect of a general election, keyed by the election's day, so that one election's answers never reach another's. src/parse/build_members_elect.py reads it and prints what is left to settle each night between the election and Organization Day.
_how: Under the election's day: "matches" maps a race and a winner's name, exactly as the results file prints it, to the member they are -- a sitting or a former member's id, which links them to that member's page -- or to null, which says they are new and nobody on file. "not_final" marks a race not final, with whether a recount was requested ({"recount": true}) and, where only some of its seats are in doubt, how many ({"seats": 1}); the winners with the fewest votes give way to them. "held" keeps a winner off the pages ({"Name": "why"}). A race is a key of site/districts.json: "H|Rockingham|13", "S|24". A reason ('why') is private and never published.

H|Rockingham|8.why: a recount was requested on 12 November
